subject: mathematics
content: Let $f:(0, \infty) \rightarrow \mathbf{R}$ be a twice differentiable function. If for some $a\ne 0, \int\limits_0^1 f(\lambda x) \mathrm{d} \mathrm{\lambda}=a f(x), f(1)=1$ and $f(16)=\frac{1}{8}$, then $16-f^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{16}\right)$ is equal to __________.
